<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Computer Vision for Autonomous Crew Health Assessment</title>
<style>
  :root{
    --cream:#F4F6EE;
    --ink:#111111;
    --body-text:#2b2b2b;
    --rule:#111111;
    --blue-accent:#1f5fd6;
    --red-accent:#e02020;
    --green-accent:#1f9d3c;
    --max-width:1180px;
  }

  *{ box-sizing:border-box; }

  html{ scroll-behavior:smooth; }

  body{
    margin:0;
    font-family:"Helvetica Neue", Arial, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;
    color:var(--body-text);
    background:#ffffff;
    line-height:1.55;
    -webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;
  }

  img{
    max-width:100%;
    display:block;
    height:auto;
  }

  a{ color:inherit; }

  /* ---------- Header ---------- */
  header.hero{
    background:var(--cream);
    padding:28px 40px 40px;
  }

  .credit{
    font-size:0.95rem;
    color:#1a1a1a;
    max-width:220px;
    line-height:1.35;
    margin-bottom:18px;
  }

  h1.title{
    text-align:center;
    font-size:clamp(2rem, 4.4vw, 3.4rem);
    font-weight:800;
    letter-spacing:-0.01em;
    margin:10px auto 0;
    max-width:900px;
    line-height:1.12;
  }

  /* ---------- Layout shell ---------- */
  main{
    max-width:var(--max-width);
    margin:0 auto;
    padding:44px 40px 80px;
  }

  .row{
    display:grid;
    grid-template-columns:1.05fr 1fr;
    gap:44px;
    align-items:start;
  }

  .row + .row{
    margin-top:56px;
  }

  @media (max-width: 860px){
    .row{
      grid-template-columns:1fr;
    }
  }

  /* ---------- Intro row ---------- */
  .device-card{
    border:1px solid #c9d6ea;
    border-radius:4px;
    overflow:hidden;
  }

  .device-card img{ width:100%; }

  h2.section-heading{
    font-size:1.5rem;
    font-weight:800;
    margin:0 0 12px;
  }

  h3.sub-heading{
    font-size:1.25rem;
    font-weight:800;
    margin:0 0 10px;
  }

  p{
    margin:0 0 14px;
    font-size:1rem;
    color:var(--body-text);
  }

  .intro-block + .intro-block{
    margin-top:26px;
  }

  /* ---------- Section title bar ---------- */
  .section-title-wrap{
    margin-top:60px;
    margin-bottom:6px;
  }

  h2.big-section{
    font-size:1.7rem;
    font-weight:800;
    margin:0 0 18px;
    padding-bottom:0;
  }

  /* ---------- Text column details ---------- */
  .stack > * + *{
    margin-top:28px;
  }

  .eye-diagrams{
    display:flex;
    gap:16px;
    margin:22px 0 22px;
  }
  .eye-diagrams img{
    border:1px solid #ddd;
    border-radius:4px;
  }

  .formula-block{
    margin:20px 0 24px;
    font-family:"Cambria","Georgia",serif;
    font-style:italic;
    font-size:1.15rem;
    color:#111;
  }

  .frac{
    display:inline-flex;
    flex-direction:column;
    align-items:center;
    vertical-align:middle;
    margin:0 6px;
    text-align:center;
  }
  .frac .num, .frac .den{
    padding:0 4px;
  }
  .frac .num{
    border-bottom:1.5px solid #111;
    padding-bottom:2px;
  }
  .frac .den{
    padding-top:2px;
  }

  .eq-line{
    display:flex;
    align-items:center;
    flex-wrap:wrap;
    gap:6px;
    margin-bottom:14px;
  }

  /* ---------- Legend list ---------- */
  .legend-list{
    list-style:none;
    margin:14px 0 22px;
    padding:0;
    font-weight:700;
    font-size:0.95rem;
  }
  .legend-list li{
    margin-bottom:6px;
    padding-left:18px;
    position:relative;
  }
  .legend-list li::before{
    content:"•";
    position:absolute;
    left:0;
    font-size:1.1rem;
    top:-2px;
  }
  .legend-list li.green{ color:var(--green-accent); }
  .legend-list li.red{ color:var(--red-accent); }
  .legend-list li.blue{ color:var(--blue-accent); }

  /* ---------- Right column screenshot stack ---------- */
  .shot-stack > * + *{
    margin-top:20px;
  }

  .shot-frame{
    border:1px solid #d7d7d7;
    border-radius:3px;
    overflow:hidden;
  }
  .shot-frame img{ width:100%; }

  .eye-anatomy-wrap{
    border:1px solid #eee;
    padding:6px 10px;
  }

  /* ---------- Feature list (Section 2) ---------- */
  .feature-list{
    margin:22px 0 0;
    padding:0;
    list-style:none;
  }
  .feature-list li{
    margin-bottom:14px;
  }
  .feature-list .feat-title{
    font-weight:700;
    display:block;
    margin-bottom:2px;
  }
  .feature-list .feat-icon{
    margin-right:6px;
  }

  .terminal-frame{
    border:1px solid #222;
    border-radius:4px;
    overflow:hidden;
    margin-top:30px;
  }
  .terminal-frame img{ width:100%; display:block; }

  footer{
    text-align:center;
    padding:30px 20px 50px;
    font-size:0.85rem;
    color:#777;
    border-top:1px solid #eee;
    margin-top:40px;
  }

  @media (max-width: 600px){
    header.hero{ padding:20px 20px 28px; }
    main{ padding:32px 20px 60px; }
    .eye-diagrams{ flex-direction:column; }
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>

<header class="hero">
  <div class="credit">Developed by My Le &amp; Arthur Alcocer</div>
  <h1 class="title">Computer Vision for Autonomous Crew Health Assessment</h1>
</header>

<main>

  <!-- Intro row: device illustration + Introduction / Framework -->
  <section class="row">
    <div class="device-card">
      <img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="Morpheus device performing the Hand Raise Test and Blink Duration Test on an astronaut">
    </div>

    <div>
      <div class="intro-block">
        <h2 class="section-heading">Introduction</h2>
        <p>Using AI-powered vision to evaluate astronaut physiological and cognitive readiness through contactless analysis.</p>
      </div>

      <div class="intro-block">
        <h2 class="section-heading">AI &amp; Computer Vision Framework</h2>
        <p>The computer vision pipeline captures live video using OpenCV before passing each frame to MediaPipe, which detects facial landmarks and estimates facial geometry. These landmarks provide precise measurements that enable real-time analysis of eye movement, blinking, facial motion, and body posture throughout each assessment.</p>
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>

  <!-- Section 1 -->
  <section class="row section-title-wrap">
    <div class="stack">
      <div>
        <h2 class="big-section">Section 1: Blink Duration &amp; Fatigue Analysis</h2>
        <p><strong>Intro:</strong> The computer vision pipeline captures live video using OpenCV before passing each frame to MediaPipe, which detects facial landmarks and estimates facial geometry. These landmarks provide precise measurements that enable real-time analysis of eye movement, blinking, facial motion, and body posture throughout each assessment.</p>
      </div>

      <div>
        <h3 class="sub-heading">Real-Time Monitoring</h3>
        <p>Rather than analyzing a single image, Morpheus continuously processes live video and updates blink statistics throughout the assessment. The system records blink count, eye-open time, eye-closed time, yawns, and EAR values while providing continuous visual feedback during testing.</p>

        <div class="eye-diagrams">
          <img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="Diagram comparing eye landmarks p1 through p6 for an open eye and a closed eye, illustrating EAR calculation">
        </div>

        <div class="formula-block">
          <div class="eq-line">
            <span><em>EAR</em> =</span>
            <span class="frac">
              <span class="num">‖P2&nbsp;&minus;&nbsp;P6‖&nbsp;+&nbsp;‖P3&nbsp;&minus;&nbsp;P5‖</span>
              <span class="den">2‖P1&nbsp;&minus;&nbsp;P4‖</span>
            </span>
          </div>
          <div class="eq-line">
            <span><em>AVG&nbsp;EAR</em> =</span>
            <span class="frac">
              <span class="num">1</span>
              <span class="den">2</span>
            </span>
            <span>(<em>EAR<sub>Left</sub></em> + <em>EAR<sub>Right</sub></em>)</span>
          </div>
        </div>

        <p>Euclidean distance measures the separation between eyelid landmarks; as the eyelids move closer together, the EAR decreases, indicating eye closure. By implementing 6 additional landmarks to each eye (height and width), we can determine if the eyes are open/close, blink duration, and the number of blinks. We use EAR to measure pixel coordinates (landmarks) from each frame and combine them to create a ratio to quantify eye openness.</p>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="shot-stack">
      <div class="shot-frame">
        <img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="Morpheus Eye and Mouth Fatigue Tracker showing 260 blinks and EYES CLOSED status">
      </div>

      <div>
        <ul class="legend-list">
          <li class="green">Eyelid outline = 6 green landmarks</li>
          <li class="red">Iris = 4 red landmarks</li>
          <li class="red">Pupil = 1 red landmark</li>
          <li class="blue">Mouth = 4 blue landmarks</li>
        </ul>
        <div class="eye-anatomy-wrap">
          <img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="Diagram labeling parts of the human eye: top lid, eyelash, pupil, iris, bottom lid, cornea, sclera, tear duct">
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="shot-frame">
        <img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="Morpheus Eye and Mouth Fatigue Tracker showing 239 blinks and EYES OPEN status">
      </div>

      <div class="shot-frame">
        <img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="Table of blink rate per minute alongside a line chart titled Blinks per Minute Trend">
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>

  <!-- Section 2 -->
  <section class="row section-title-wrap">
    <div class="stack">
      <div>
        <h2 class="big-section">Section 2: Blink Duration &amp; Fatigue Analysis</h2>
        <p><strong>Intro:</strong> Following prolonged EVA/spacewalk operations, astronauts may experience temporary changes in coordination, mobility, and reaction performance. Morpheus uses computer vision to perform a contactless balance assessment by tracking upper-body movement and measuring the time required to complete a standardized reaching task. The assessment provides an objective comparison between an astronaut's pre- and post-EVA performance.</p>

        <ul class="feature-list">
          <li>
            <span class="feat-title">🎯 Target Tracking</span>
            Detects when both wrists reach the virtual target line.
          </li>
          <li>
            <span class="feat-title">⏱ Reaction Time</span>
            Measures the time required to complete each movement.
          </li>
          <li>
            <span class="feat-title">📊 Median Analysis</span>
            Uses the median of multiple trials to improve reliability.
          </li>
          <li>
            <span class="feat-title">👤 Personal Baseline</span>
            Compares POST performance against the astronaut's own PRE assessment.
          </li>
        </ul>
      </div>

      <div class="terminal-frame">
        <img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="Terminal output showing the Morpheus session result for Astronaut Mike, including trial delays, status, and session summary">
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="shot-stack">
      <div class="shot-frame">
        <img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="Morpheus EVA Fatigue Check PRE trial screenshot with a green target line and pose tracking overlay">
      </div>

      <div class="shot-frame">
        <img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="Data table of person_id, session_id, mode, trial_num, timestamp, delay_sec, baseline_sec, ratio_vs_pre, and status for PRE and POST trials">
      </div>

      <div class="shot-frame">
        <img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="Morpheus EVA Fatigue Check POST trial screenshot with a red target line and pose tracking overlay">
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>

</main>

<footer>
  Morpheus &mdash; Computer Vision for Autonomous Crew Health Assessment. Developed by My Le &amp; Arthur Alcocer.
</footer>

</body>
</html>
